newsitem.title: LATVIA: SHARES EASE AS ACTIVITY ALMOST GRINDS TO A HALT.
newsitem.headline: SHARES EASE AS ACTIVITY ALMOST GRINDS TO A HALT.

text.p: * Four of the five official list shares that were quoted on Friday eased.
* Overall market turnover was a paltry 27,000 lats.
* The Rietumu index inched down 0.5 percent to 151.64.
* The Riga Transport Fleet was the biggest loser on the official list, easing 1.7 percent to 1.15 lats.
The summer bears took another bite out of Latvia's market on Friday as shares eased in extremely low turnover.
Activity almost ground to a halt, with only 27,000 lats worth of shares changing hands and the Rietumu index shedding 0.5 percent to 151.64. The bourse index fell 2.72 points to 382.20.
The four shares quoted from the five-stock official list all eased, with the Riga Transport Fleet falling the most as it dropped 1.7 percent to 1.15 lats in trade of only 200 lats.
Dealers said the fleet was not expected to fall much more as its price was beginning to look like a bargain and its six-month results, due out at the end of July, are expected to be good.

The Riga Shipyard lost a santime to 1.27 lats in trade of 8,000 lats and dealers said it was expected to fall a bit more as employees, who obtained their shares for free, attempt to shed them for extra cash ahead of their summer holidays.
